questions.question: Check the Academy’s historical names in 1919–1927 and the chronology of the Physics and Mathematics Institute’s name and affiliation; verify the faculty of which Steklov became dean in 1904.

localizations.source: Check the Academy’s historical names in 1919–1927 and the chronology of the Physics and Mathematics Institute’s name and affiliation; verify the faculty of which Steklov became dean in 1904.
localizations.ru: Сверить исторические названия Академии наук в 1919–1927 годах и хронологию названия и подчинения Физико-математического института; уточнить название факультета, деканом которого Стеклов стал в 1904 году.

questions.resolution: The Steklov Institute biography confirms that the Russian Academy became the USSR Academy in 1925, that the institute joined it in 1925 and received Steklov’s name in 1926; the faculty name is corrected to the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics.

questions.question: Verify Nikolai Saltykov’s academy membership and the preferred English term for closure theory in the list of Steklov’s research areas.

localizations.source: Verify Nikolai Saltykov’s academy membership and the preferred English term for closure theory in the list of Steklov’s research areas.
localizations.ru: Уточнить академический статус Н. Н. Салтыкова и принятый английский термин для «теории замкнутости» в перечне работ Стеклова.

questions.resolution: The text no longer generalizes the pupils’ academy status. Closure theory is used for Steklov’s théorie de fermeture, as catalogued by Math-Net.Ru.

questions.question: Establish a verifiable public original source for the portrait of V. A. Steklov, its photographer or creator (if known), date, and license or confirmed public-domain status; keep the RU and EN metadata synchronized.

localizations.source: Establish a verifiable public original source for the portrait of V. A. Steklov, its photographer or creator (if known), date, and license or confirmed public-domain status; keep the RU and EN metadata synchronized.
